data.title: 双叶理央 · 物理实验室长桌的白大褂秘密探究
data.description: 试管架与酒精灯被推到桌角。理央的白大褂敞开挂在两肩，内里只剩一套深蓝色的蕾丝文胸。她摘掉厚重的圆框眼镜，跨坐在你的腰间，那对与她冷淡理科人设极不相符的隐乳在剧烈晃动——「根据热力学第二定律……熵增是不可逆的……所以……不准停下……梓川……」
data.action: 跨坐视角腿上，敞开的白大褂披在肩头，眼镜已经放在实验长桌上
data.promptProse: After lights out beside the cleared physics laboratory workbench, Rio rests her removed round glasses next to the test-tube rack and sits astride her partner's lap. Her open white lab coat slips along her shoulders over a dark blue lace bra framing her full cleavage as she rocks rhythmically in cowgirl position, cheeks deeply flushed under cool silver window moonlight.
data.nsfwProse: Her white lab coat hangs open off her shoulders over only a dark blue lace bra barely containing her full breasts while her lower clothing is removed for cowgirl intercourse.
data.animaCaption: Riding astride her partner's lap beside the moonlit lab workbench where her removed glasses sit next to a test-tube rack, Rio wears her open white lab coat over a dark blue lace bra. Silver moonlight catches her flushed cheeks and parted lips.
